name: MailingLabel
remarks: Use the MailingLabel property to return the MailingLabel object. The following example sets default mailing label options. Use the PrintOut method to print a mailing label listed in the Product Number box in the Label Options dialog box. The following example prints a page of Avery 5162 standard address labels using the specified address. Use the CustomLabels property to format or print a custom mailing label. The following example sets the number of labels across and down for the custom label named "MyLabel."

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified MailingLabel object.

properties.name: DefaultLaserTray
properties.description: Returns or sets the default paper tray that contains sheets of mailing labels. Read/write WdPaperTray.

properties.name: CustomLabels
properties.description: Returns a CustomLabels collection that represents the available custom mailing labels. Read-only.

properties.name: DefaultLabelName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name for the default mailing label. Read/write String.

properties.name: Vertical
properties.description: True vertically orients text on Asian mailing labels. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: LabelOptions
methods.description: Displays the Label Options dialog box.

methods.name: CreateNewDocument
methods.signature: CreateNewDocument([Name As Variant], [Address As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [ExtractAddress As Variant], [LaserTray As Variant], [PrintEPostageLabel As Variant], [Vertical As Variant]) As Document
methods.description: Creates a new label document using either the default label options or ones that you specify. Returns a Document object that represents the new document.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The mailing label name.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The text for the mailing label.

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: The name of the AutoText entry that includes the mailing label text.

parameters.name: ExtractAddress
parameters.description: True to use the address text marked by the user-defined bookmark named "EnvelopeAddress" instead of using the Address argument.

parameters.name: LaserTray
parameters.description: The laser printer tray. Can be one of the WdPaperTray constants.

parameters.name: PrintEPostageLabel
parameters.description: True to print postage using an Internet e-postage vendor.

parameters.name: Vertical
parameters.description: True formats text vertically on the label. Used for Asian-language mailing labels.

methods.name: PrintOut
methods.signature: PrintOut([Name As Variant], [Address As Variant], [ExtractAddress As Variant], [LaserTray As Variant], [SingleLabel As Variant], [Row As Variant], [Column As Variant], [PrintEPostageLabel As Variant], [Vertical As Variant])
methods.description: Prints a label or a page of labels with the same address.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The mailing label name.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The text for the label address.

parameters.name: ExtractAddress
parameters.description: True to use the text marked by the "EnvelopeAddress" bookmark (a user-defined bookmark) as the label text. If this argument is specified, Address and AutoText are ignored.

parameters.name: LaserTray
parameters.description: The laser printer tray to be used. Can be any WdPaperTray constant.

parameters.name: SingleLabel
parameters.description: True to print a single label; False to print an entire page of the same label.

parameters.name: Row
parameters.description: The label row for a single label. Not valid if SingleLabel is False.

parameters.name: Column
parameters.description: The label column for a single label. Not valid if SingleLabel is False.

parameters.name: PrintEPostageLabel
parameters.description: True to print postage using an Internet e-postage vendor.

parameters.name: Vertical
parameters.description: True prints text vertically on the label. Used for Asian-language mailing labels.
